title: At 360 px a plain load of /<site>/ keeps the composer in sight: the site preview is placed behind the toggle; a ?tab= link still opens the column
steps: S1: As A (owner) open $O/<site>/ in a fresh 360x800 mobile context; wait for [data-composer-input="true"] plus 8 s (a Playwright wait grants the page a transient user activation, which is the condition that used to let the load's open through). Read whether [data-sidebar-right-panel] carries data-sidebar-right-open, and document.elementFromPoint at the composer's centre.
S2: Same at 1440x900 in a fresh context.
S3: In a fresh 360x800 context open $O/<site>/?tab=tracy:my-sites and wait 14 s; read [data-sidebar-right-panel][data-sidebar-right-open].
expect: S1: no [data-sidebar-right-panel][data-sidebar-right-open]; the point lands inside [data-composer-card] (or in the Getting started dialog when it is up), never inside [data-rightbar-session]; openTabsOf('tracy:browser') still lists the site's preview.
S2: [data-sidebar-right-panel][data-sidebar-right-open] present (the preview opens beside the chat as before).
evidence: Dev acceptance 12/10/2026 (develop 245be29854, fork tracy.42) at 360 px: the Browser tab covered the composer although [data-rightbar-collapsed] was set (that attribute stays set while the fullscreen panel slides in; read the panel's own data-sidebar-right-open). Opener: tracy-add-site ensure() -> show(own) -> revealTab (explicit expand) or openSite after the credentials await, passing the fork's userActivation check.
fence: @tracy/core/tab-link openUnasked/focusUnasked + tracy-add-site bringPreview: on a narrow frame the page's own load never expands a collapsed column; presses and ?tab= still do
